name: Malkishua
title: Saul's Fallen Son
summary: Malkishua was one of King Saul's sons who fought alongside his father in the war against the Philistines. He fell together with his brothers Jonathan and Abinadab in the fateful battle at Mount Gilboa, where King Saul also lost his life.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among Saul's sons
keyEvents.description: Malkishua is mentioned as one of Saul's sons in the list of the king's family.

keyEvents.title: Fell at the Battle of Gilboa
keyEvents.description: Malkishua died together with his brothers Jonathan and Abinadab when the Philistines won the decisive battle on Mount Gilboa.

keyEvents.title: Body hung up by the Philistines
keyEvents.description: After the battle, the Philistines hung the bodies of Saul and his sons on the city wall in Beth Shan as a humiliation.

keyEvents.title: Buried in Jabesh
keyEvents.description: Men from Jabesh in Gilead retrieved the bodies of Saul and his sons and buried them under the tamarisk tree in Jabesh.

keyEvents.title: David's Lament
keyEvents.description: David mourned for Saul and Jonathan in his lament, which also included grief over the entire royal house that fell in battle.
